===''Pokemon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|RS}}==== Anabel appeared in ''[[AG169|Talking a Good Game!]]'' and ''[[AG170|Second Time's the Charm!]]'', where she battled {{Ash}} twice for his penultimate {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}} challenge. Ash lost their first battle, but he managed to defeat her in a [[rematch]]. ===={{aniseries|DP}}==== Palmer debuted in a cameo at the beginning of ''[[M12|Arceus and the Jewel of Life]]'', where he battled {{an|Cynthia}}. He made his {{pkmn|animated series}} debut in ''[[DP140|Historical Mystery Tour!]]'', where he met up with his son {{an|Barry}}. In ''[[DP141|Challenging a Towering Figure!]]'', he battled Ash at the [[Twinleaf Festival]] and won. {{-}} ==In the manga== [[File:Palmer Adventures.png|thumb|230px|[[Palmer]] in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] [[File:Anabel CBF.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Anabel]] in [[Pokémon Battle Frontier]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== ===={{MangaArc|Emerald}}==== Anabel, along with the rest of the [[Generation III]] [[Frontier Brain]]s, appeared in this arc, assisting in fighting against the villainous [[Guile Hideout]]. She is considered to be the strongest of the [[Hoenn]] Frontier Brains, being in possession of {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Raikou}}. ===={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}==== Palmer made a brief appearance while encountering [[Cynthia]], revealing that he was in possession of [[Reg]]igigas at the time, though he was planning on {{pkmn2|Released|releasing}} it. ===={{MangaArc|Platinum}}==== Palmer appeared in this arc, assisting in fighting against [[Team Galactic]] in the [[Distortion World]] with his {{pkmn2|Legendary}} partner Pokémon, {{p|Cresselia}}. By the end of the arc, he remained the only [[Sinnoh]] Frontier Brain yet to be challenged by {{adv|Platinum}}. He is the father of {{adv|Pearl}}, one of Sinnoh's [[Pokédex holder]]s. ===={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}==== Anabel reappeared alongside the other Hoenn Frontier Brains to help in stopping the [[Admin]]s of Neo [[Team Aqua]] and Neo [[Team Magma]]. ===Pokémon Battle Frontier=== Anabel appeared in the [[Pokémon Battle Frontier]] {{pkmn|manga}}. She first appeared dressed up as a [[Photography|photographer]], but was later revealed to be the Frontier Brain of the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}. She was the last Frontier Brain challenged by {{OBP|Enta|CBF}}; their battle ended in a draw, leaving Enta without his final [[Symbol|Frontier Symbol]]. ===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!=== Palmer appeared in ''[[DPA28|Look for Giratina!]]'' as [[Hareta]] and his friends arrived at the [[Battle Zone]]. Pretending to be a member of [[Team Galactic]], he challenged Hareta to a battle, but once the battle had ended in a draw, he revealed his true identity and was revealed to be {{OBP|Jun|DPA}}'s father and friends with Hareta's father, [[Kaisei]]. {{-}} ==Trivia== * Though the word "{{wp|Business magnate#Etymology|tycoon}}" is actually derived from the Japanese word {{j|{{jwp|征夷大将軍|大君}}}} ''taikun'' (a title for the {{wp|shogun}}), it is converted into {{wp|katakana}} as an English term to match the names of the other Frontier Brains' Trainer classes, rather than using the {{wp|hiragana}} {{j|たいくん}} or its respective katakana {{j|タイクン}} (without the lengthening {{wp|chōonpu}}). ==In other languages== {{langtable|color={{tower color light}}|bordercolor={{tower color}} |zh_yue=對戰塔大君 ''{{tt|Deuijin Taap Daaihgwān|Battle Tower Tycoon}}'' {{tt|*|Games}}
